name: [Spellbook 129-184-4682] Infinite card draw for all players, Infinite draw triggers for all players, Near-infinite Treasure tokens, Near-infinite colored mana, Near-infinite colorless mana

other:
Notable prerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

Spellbook description: Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Kinnan triggers twice, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

PHASE 3 REVIEW NOTE (this agent, 2026-08-12, not yet cross-checked in an executable engine): This line's mana math has the same shape as INT-0006's - a hand-parse of the Spellbook description suggests the loop may be closer to break-even than strictly net-positive at the stated opponent-count threshold, but the partial Treasure-cracking described (not every Treasure created is spent each cycle) makes this genuinely hard to verify by hand without risking a fresh arithmetic error - explicitly NOT asserting a corrected number here, deferring to real engine reproduction (INFRA-0003) rather than compounding one hand-parse with another. MORE IMPORTANT than the exact mana count: this line requires opponents to not pay Smothering Tithe's {2} tax, which is an opponent decision, not something under this deck's control - materially different reliability than the Devoted Druid lines (INT-0002/0003), which only depend on this player's own board state. Should be modeled and reported separately in Phase 26 combo-accessibility analysis, not lumped in with fully self-contained lines.
